#| label: fig-distribution

if C.HAS_MATPLOTLIB:
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4))
    axes[0].hist(raw["value"], bins=40, color="#4c72b0", edgecolor="white")
    axes[0].set_title("Raw scale")
    axes[1].hist(np.log1p(raw["value"]), bins=40, color="#dd8452", edgecolor="white")
    axes[1].set_title("Log scale")
    for ax in axes:
        ax.set_ylabel("Count")
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig
else:
    print("Install matplotlib to render this figure.")
